name: Smart Watch Series X
description:
The Smart Watch Series X combines elegant design with powerful health tracking. Featuring a 1.9" AMOLED display, heart rate monitor, SpO2 sensor, sleep tracking, and 100+ sports modes — stay on top of your health in style.

**Why You'll Love It:**
- Stunning 1.9" AMOLED always-on display with 1000 nits brightness
- 24/7 Heart Rate, SpO2, and Sleep monitoring
- 100+ Sports modes with GPS tracking
- 14-day battery life on a single charge
- IP68 water resistant — swim-proof
- Customizable watch faces and straps
deliveryInfo: Delivery in 2-3 working days across Pakistan
